title: 3900. Longest Balanced Substring After One Swap

examples.explanation: Swap "100001". The string becomes "101000". Select the substring "101000", which is balanced because it has two '0's and two '1's.
Choose not to perform any swaps. Select the empty substring, which is balanced because it has zero '0's and zero '1's.
